source: Apple public iTunes Search and Lookup APIs; official store provider disclosures; linked creator and Ukrainian product sources for origin evidence
verification: Each included ID was returned by a fresh Apple public API response and lists iPhone support. Names, developers, icons and store URLs come from that response. Summaries describe listing claims, not hands-on testing.
scope: A curated, incomplete index of distinct App Store listings. This is not the number of expense trackers in the App Store. Search rankings, storefront availability and manual selection limit coverage.

discovery.candidateCountMeaning: Raw distinct IDs across broad search responses, including unrelated and unreviewed apps. Not a relevant-app count or store census.
discovery.requestPolicy: Sequential discovery requests with a 3.25-second pause. Stop on API errors; no scraping protection bypass.
discovery.publication: The discovery script only writes unreviewed candidates. Catalog additions require title and description review.

excludes: banking or payment apps without a central expense-tracking use
obvious paid/pro duplicates of an already included product
selection.reviewedPools: Original 45 listings; first 145 US discovery candidates; selected UA/GB discoveries; additional named, travel, budgeting, receipt and shared-expense listings. Not every raw candidate was reviewed.

ukrainianAudit.method: Reviewed five Ukrainian-language public API searches, prioritized 213 previously unindexed tracker candidates with Ukrainian language support, and checked their official provider disclosures plus 14 existing leads. Combined explicit Ukraine disclosures with named leads from Ukrainian product directories, creator announcements, and official product websites. Reviewed listing descriptions for expense/budget relevance. Language and names were discovery aids, never origin proof. Also checked the remaining 36 already-indexed listings with Ukrainian language support returned by the same five queries.
ukrainianAudit.requestPolicy: Public API requests and sequential official store page requests; provider checks paused 500 ms between requests and stopped on any HTTP 403/429. No protections bypassed.
ukrainianAudit.originStandard: Explicit creator/team origin statement, official developer/operator country disclosure, or a cited Ukrainian product source. Directory assertions and current developer country are evidence of a Ukrainian connection, not certification of every contributor or present legal domicile.

exclusions.name: Quartal Finance
exclusions.reason: Confirmed Ukrainian provider but listing establishes income/tax/invoicing features, not expense tracking or spending budgets.

ukrainianAudit.limitations: This is a bounded multi-source audit, not an exhaustive registry. Search rankings can omit listings; Ukrainian-created apps without Ukrainian localization or public origin disclosures can be missed. Missing or non-Ukrainian current provider disclosures do not prove non-Ukrainian origin. Beta-only, web-only, unavailable, and out-of-scope leads are not counted as public iOS tracker listings.
